7.16 Read Tx/Rx notification status
In addition to the notification callback functions
CanIf
provides the API service
CanIf_ReadTxNotifStatus()
(see [SWS_CANIF_00202]) to read the transmit
confirmation status of any transmit
L-SDU
and the API service
CanIf_ReadRxNo-
tifStatus()
is provided to read the receive indication status of any receive
L-SDU

abled/disabled globally or per

,

cReadRxPduNotifyStatusApi
